dialogue_texts: Yukari
A festival born from a daughter's grief...
Yukari
Yet the boundaries of this parallel are fraying like a cheap silk gown. How terribly unrefined.
Koakuma
Stop right there, Queen of Boundaries! You think you can just saunter through the Kozankyo Cemetery?
Yukari
My, a little library bat flapping its wings far away from its bookshelves.
Koakuma
The Grieg twins fell, but the Order's revenge is far from extinguished!
Koakuma
The Scarlet Devil's wrath guides us now!
Koakuma
We will rewrite this broken parallel, and Kozankyo will be the first to dissolve!
Yukari
A sovereign does not mess with an assistant, little one.
Yukari
If you block my view of the festival, I shall simply close the gap between you and a very long, dark confinement.
Koakuma
I'm not afraid of your gaps! With the Order's vengeance fully prepared, your boundaries mean nothing!
